blocks.arabic_text: فَيَعْرِفُونَهُمْ فِي النَّارِ يَعْرِفُونَهُمْ بِأَثَرِ السُّجُودِ، تَأْكُلُ النَّارُ مِنَ ابْنِ آدَمَ إِلَّا أَثَرَ السُّجُودِ، حَرَّمَ اللهُ عَلَي النَّارِ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ أَثَرَ السُّجُودِ، فَيُخْرَجُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب معرفة طريق الرؤية رقم:٤٥١
blocks.tamil_translation: “After Allah has finished passing judgement on His servants, intending through His mercy to bring out of Jahannam whomever He wishes, He will say, “Bring out of Jahannam those who, without associating partners with Allah in the world, said “La ilaha illallah'”. The angels will recognise them by the marks of sajdah. The fire of Jahannam will burn the other parts of the body except the marks of sajdah. For Allah has made it haram for the fire of Jahannam to burn the marks of sajdah. (Those whom the angels were commanded to bring out) will be brought out of Jahannam.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) has narrated that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The marks of sajdah are the seven limbs a person uses to make sajdah. They are the forehead, the two hands, the two knees and the two feet.(Nawawi)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ يُعَلِّمُنَا التَّشَهُّدَ كَمَا يُعَلِّمُنَا السُّورَةَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب التشهد في الصلاة رقم:٩٠٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates, “Rasulullah ﷺ used to teach us the “Tashahhud” just as he taught us the surahs of the Qur'an'.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ خَفَّافِ بْنِ إِيمَاءَ بْنِ رَحَضَةَ الْغِفَارِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: كَانَ
